tools.name: omikuji_draw
tools.description: Draw the daily fortune slip. With no arguments it returns today's slip; pass date (YYYY-MM-DD) to read the slip of another day. The slip for a date is fixed on this machine, so drawing it again never changes it. In built-in wording mode the reply is the finished slip: lot number, grade, score, verse, reading, what to favour, what to avoid and a lucky colour. In pet wording mode the reply is the facts plus writing constraints instead, and omikuji_record stores the slip you write.

date.description: Calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for today in the deployment timezone.

summary.zh: 取某一天的签；不传日期就是今天。同一天在同一台机器上永远是同一张。
summary.en: Returns the slip for a date, today by default. The same date is the same slip on this machine.

tools.name: omikuji_record
tools.description: Store the slip you wrote for a date, in pet wording mode only. The first text stored for a date is kept and every later draw returns it unchanged, so record once and do not rewrite it. Returns the stored text.

text.description: The slip itself: two short lines, 14–18 characters in total, no predictions stated as fact.

date.description: Calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for today in the deployment timezone.

summary.zh: 把桌宠自己写好的那一签记下来；同一天只认第一份。
summary.en: Stores the slip the pet wrote; the first text for a date is the one kept.

description.zh: World 挂载完成，附今天这一签的档位与分数。
description.en: The World was mounted, with today's grade and score.
